title: Safe
alt: A child rests a hand on a stair rail beside steps rising gently.
scene: Close view of one child’s hand resting gently on a stair rail. Three broad stairs recede upward. Hand is visibly touching the rail, no alarm or falling.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. Close view of one child’s hand resting gently on a stair rail. Three broad stairs recede upward. Hand is visibly touching the rail, no alarm or falling. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
